user_prompt: Please select the single project from this shortlist of 20 that best matches Fatima Sarah Khalid values and scoring criteria. State your winner clearly and explain your reasoning in 3-4 sentences.
raw_response:
My winner is: Decidim — Free/libre open source platform for citizen participation.

Decidim aligns closely with my values because it is a genuinely open source project with permissive licensing and active community governance, serving government and public sector needs, and building public digital commons. It has a strong record of civic infrastructure value, having been deployed by hundreds of governments worldwide, and demonstrates a commitment to community governance through its cooperative governance model. Additionally, Decidim's explicit focus on citizen participation and democratic engagement aligns with my emphasis on civic public infrastructure and community-driven governance.
